senses.gloss:
फक्क् {c1c} P. (फक्कति, फक्कित)
1 To
move slowly, go softly, glide, creep.
--2 To act wrongly, behave ill.
--3
To swell.
--4 To have a
preconceived opinion.

1 A position, an
argument to be proved, a thesis or
assertion to be maintained;
फणिभाषितभाष्यफक्किका विषमा कुंडलनामवापिता
N. 2. 95.
--2 A prejudice,
preconceived opinion.
--3 A sophistical
argument, sophism.
--4 A trick, fraud.
--5 Logical exposition.
